Test Case 2: Helmfile Configuration Validation

Input: Check helmfile.yaml.gotmpl structure

Expected Output:
- File exists: repos/platform/deployments/metabob/helmfile.yaml.gotmpl
- Environments configured: local, prod, integration, research, ops
- Local environment has kubeContext: docker-desktop

Validation:
- Helmfile must define all required environments
- Each environment must have environment-specific values files
- Local environment must target docker-desktop context
- Verifies DRY principle: single helmfile works across all environments
